title: Camping and rest
summary: Hours, ambush odds, who finds you
lede: Camp for one to nine hours. Rest heals the party when it is long enough, and the longer you stay, the more chances for something to find you.

items.label: Ambush chance
items.note: Per hour change, guarded or not.

items.label: Healing
items.note: Each eligible member, up to their maximum. Needs 6+ hours.

items.label: Wanderer
items.note: Outdoors only, after a qualifying rest.

blocks.text: Outdoors you need dry land and a party on foot. A ship cannot camp; it is repaired instead. A watch is offered only when more than one member is Good or Poisoned, and the guard you pick has to be Good.

blocks.label: Redux differs
blocks.text: Horses stay mounted and a magic carpet goes into your pack. See [Differences you'll notice](/redux/differences/#camp-0001).
When an ambush comes, the creature is chosen from a fixed list of eight entries. A dash means that creature never ambushes there. In a dungeon the choice is made before you start resting.

After a rest of six hours or more, each party member gains between 1 and 63 HP, up to their maximum. The guard, the poisoned and the dead are left out. Mages and the Avatar then have MP equal to their INT; Bards get half their INT.
Step by step, with every roll: [Camping, step by step](/original/how/camping/).
